title: “A Tale of Two Movements”: Identifying and Comparing Perspectives in #BlackLivesMatter and #BlueLivesMatter Movements-related Tweets using Weakly Supervised Graph-based Structured Prediction
reasoning: The paper uses Moral Foundation Theory (MFT) to identify and analyze the moral perspectives of different social movements. It categorizes social discourse based on moral foundations such as fairness/cheating, authority/subversion, and loyalty/betrayal as a central part of its methodology.
